issuePngs.caption: Landing, 1280px. Hero CTAs: visible text 'Get started — it's free' / 'I already have an account' is not in their accessible names 'Sign up for CareConnect' / 'Sign in to CareConnect' (axe label-content-name-mismatch, WCAG 2.5.3). Landing.tsx:124-138.
Sign up, 1280px. Privacy note text-xs text-neutral-400 on white = 2.84:1, needs 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). SignUp.tsx:171.
Role chooser, 1280px. Two helper lines text-sm text-neutral-400 on neutral-50 = 2.68:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). RoleChooser.tsx:62, 90.
Care recipient Today, 1280px. 'NEXT THING TO DO' label 2.84:1 (Today.tsx:175) and the desktop footer text 2.84:1 (Layout.tsx:432) (WCAG 1.4.3).
Care recipient header, every route. Visible 'Call my caregiver' vs accessible name 'Call your caregiver: Joyce — 07700 900 456' (WCAG 2.5.3). Layout.tsx:275-282.
My Day, 1280px. Done items sit in opacity-60 cards: titles 1.76:1, descriptions 2.44:1, badges 2.6-2.95:1, times 3.13:1; hint 'Tap the circle…' 2.68:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). Schedule.tsx:86-114, 164.
My Appointments, 1280px. Location-type labels (2.84:1) and the reassurance note (2.68:1) use text-neutral-400 (WCAG 1.4.3). Appointments.tsx:185, 391.
My Appointments. 'Add to My Day' buttons are named 'Add "<title>" to My Day schedule', so the visible label is not contained (WCAG 2.5.3). Appointments.tsx:247-254.
Medicines, 1280px. Taken medicines sit in opacity-60 cards (1.76-2.95:1) and the disclaimer is 2.68:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). Medications.tsx:116-145, 167.
Manage medications. 'Add medication' button is named 'Add new medication' (WCAG 2.5.3). ManageMedications.tsx:407-415.
Manage appointments, 1280px. Addresses in text-neutral-400 on white = 2.84:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). ManageAppointments.tsx:452.
Caregiver Dashboard, 1280px. Empty-activity hint (text-sm) and the refresh footnote (text-xs) in text-neutral-400, 2.84:1 / 2.68:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). CaregiverDashboard.tsx:424, 547.

Caregiver Dashboard. Four quick-link cards whose aria-label drops the visible sub-text, plus the sidebar 'Switch to patient' button named 'Switch to care recipient role' (WCAG 2.5.3). CaregiverDashboard.tsx:451-541, Layout.tsx:372-379.

Landing with the assistant open (replies are the scripted fallback; with VITE_SUPABASE_URL unset each message POSTs to /undefined/functions/v1/chat-assistant and gets a 404). The conversation list scrolls but contains nothing focusable, so keyboard users cannot scroll earlier messages (axe scrollable-region-focusable, WCAG 2.1.1). ChatBot.tsx:267-270.
My Day after every task is ticked: the whole list drops below contrast minimums (41 nodes) because done cards use opacity-60. Schedule.tsx:86-88.
Medicines after every medicine is ticked: 19 contrast failures from opacity-60 cards. Medications.tsx:116.
Add medication form. 'Add another time' button is named 'Add another scheduled time' (WCAG 2.5.3). ManageMedications.tsx:261-269.
Caregiver Dashboard with activity events: event-type labels and 'Nh ago' times are text-xs text-neutral-400, 2.84:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). CaregiverDashboard.tsx:254, 260.
Activity log with events: event-kind labels (text-xs) and the per-day count (text-sm) in text-neutral-400 (WCAG 1.4.3). ActivityLog.tsx:108, 200.
Landing on load: focus is already on the chat launcher (bottom-right), so the first Tab leaves the page and the skip link is not the first stop (WCAG 2.4.3). ChatBot.tsx:129-135.

Landing: 'Get started — it's free' has keyboard focus (magenta box marks the CTA group). The 3px #146488 ring sits on the calm-700→600 gradient at about 1.1-1.3:1 and cannot be seen (WCAG 2.4.7, 1.4.11). index.css:49-53, Landing.tsx:96-139.
Landing: 'I already have an account' has keyboard focus; same invisible ring on the gradient (WCAG 2.4.7, 1.4.11).

Today at 390px with the install banner, rendered by a synthetic beforeinstallprompt event (headless Chromium never fires the real one). Header + banner + bottom nav leave about 100px of content; Esc / Not now / Install drop focus to <body>. InstallPrompt.tsx:109-118.

Header at 1280px: the wordmark and the 'Switch role' / 'Sign out' labels never render because tailwind.config.js defines no sm breakpoint, so these are icon-only at every width. tailwind.config.js:6-9, Layout.tsx:181, 214, 223.

Manage medications on load: focus jumps to the last 'Delete' button and the page scrolls to it (WCAG 2.4.3). ConfirmDialog.tsx:95-99 runs its focus-return effect on mount for every danger Button (Button.tsx:116-125).
Delete dialog at 390px: opens off-centre with Cancel below the fold; 'Yes, delete' is stacked above 'Cancel' at every width (flex-col-reverse, dead sm:). ConfirmDialog.tsx:117-123, 179.
Manage appointments on load: focus jumps to the last 'Delete' button, page scrolled about 1566px (WCAG 2.4.3). Same cause as 25.
Delete appointment dialog at 390px: same off-centre placement and stacked destructive-first buttons as 26.
My Day: unchecked task toggles are text-neutral-300 (#c4cad5) circles on white, 1.6:1; the only visual cue for the control needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Schedule.tsx:128, Medications.tsx:157.
Caregiver desktop scrolled 600px: the sidebar slides under the 222px sticky header (it is a stretched flex item, so lg:sticky never engages, and --header-h is never set). Layout.tsx:323-339.
Landing at 320px (400% zoom): header nav runs to 410px; 'Sign up' is clipped by html/body overflow-x: clip and 'Sign in' wraps (WCAG 1.4.10). Landing.tsx:54-88, index.css:22-26.
Caregiver Notes at 320px: 'Add note' button extends to 374px and is cut off (WCAG 1.4.10). Caregiver.tsx:62-79.
Manage appointments at 320px: the h1 'Manage appointments' is 341px wide and its end is clipped (WCAG 1.4.10). ManageAppointments.tsx:546-549.
Today at 1280px: Tab reaches the footer link 'View contacts', which is fully behind the fixed bottom nav. The care-recipient footer is never visible at ≥1024px (WCAG 2.4.7). Layout.tsx:313, 386-441.
Contacts at 1280px: focused 'Call Dr. Priya Sharma' link is scrolled to the viewport edge and fully hidden by the bottom nav (WCAG 2.4.7).

My Day at 390px: the focused toggle for 'Breakfast' is two-thirds behind the fixed bottom nav (partly hidden = WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11, not a 2.1 failure); the next stop, 'Lunch', is fully hidden (WCAG 2.1 SC 2.4.7).
Medicines at 390px: focused 'Mark Atorvastatin as taken' is fully behind the bottom nav (WCAG 2.4.7).
Caregiver Contacts at 1280px: Tab moves from the page into the sidebar; the focused 'Dashboard', 'Medications' and 'Appointments' links are under the sticky header and invisible (WCAG 2.4.7).

Care recipient at 320x256 CSS px (a 1280x1024 window at 400% zoom): 403px sticky header + 70px fixed bottom nav, so 0px of page content is visible at any scroll position (WCAG 1.4.10). Layout.tsx:163-166, 386-389.
Caregiver at 320x256 CSS px (1280x1024 at 400% zoom): the 353px sticky header fills the viewport; 0px of content visible (WCAG 1.4.10).

Delete dialog opened by pointer from the top of the list at 1280px: the page jumps 704px, the backdrop dims only <main> (the sidebar is outside the backdrop) and the sticky header scrolls away. <main class='page-enter'> keeps transform: translateY(0) after its animation (fill-mode forwards), so the position:fixed dialog is laid out against <main>, not the viewport. index.css:202-207, Layout.tsx:309, ConfirmDialog.tsx:118.
Same at 390px: page jumps 2015px and the dialog's bottom (Cancel) is below the fold.
